title: Ukukhishwa kwe-Kyber 0.25
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
I-Kyber 0.25 isifikile!

I-Kyber 0.25 isiphumile.

Lolu shicilelo luletha ukusekelwa kwe-IPv6 kuyo yonke indawo, indlela entsha yokuthwebula isikrini nge-DRM/KMS ku-Linux, nesithonjana kuthreyi yesistimu ku-Windows. Luphinde lulethe inqwaba yezithuthukisi ezenza uhlelo luthembeke futhi lube lula ukusebenzisa.

Nanka amaphuzu agqamile.

Ukusekelwa kwe-IPv6

Kokubili iklayenti ledeskithophu nelewebhu manje sekusekela i-IPv6 . Ungaxhuma ngamanethiwekhi e-IPv6 noma ezindaweni ezisebenzisa i-IPv4 ne-IPv6 ngesikhathi esisodwa ngaphandle kokulungiselela okwengeziwe. Ukuthembeka kufana nalokho obungakulindela ku-IPv4.

Lesi sici besisathuthukiswa unyaka wonke odlule, futhi manje sesifakiwe kulolu shicilelo.

Ukuthwebula isikrini nge-DRM/KMS ku-Linux

I-Linux ithola indlela entsha yokuthwebula esekelwe ku-DRM/KMS , engezelela ezinketho ezikhona kakade ze-X11 ne-NvFBC.

I-DRM/KMS ithwebula ngqo ezingeni lomshayeli wesibonisi. Lokhu kuyenza ibe wusizo ezinhlelweni ezingenayo indawo yedeskithophu evamile, njengamaseva angenasikrini noma imishini yokusakaza esebenza ngqo phezu kwezingxenyekazi zekhompyutha.

Isithonjana sethreyi yesistimu ku-Windows

Iseva ye-Windows manje ikhombisa isithonjana kuthreyi yesistimu. Lesi sithonjana sikukhombisa ngokushesha isimo seseva, ngaphandle kokuthi kudingeke uphenye kuthheminali noma kumphathi wemisebenzi.

Ukuphatha ukukhishwa kwesibonisi ku-Windows

Iseva yokuthwebula nokubhala ngekhodi ku-Windows manje isiyakwazi ukuphatha kahle izenzakalo zokukhishwa kwesibonisi phakathi neseshini yokusakaza esebenzayo. Ngaphambilini, ukukhipha isikrini lapho uhlelo lusasebenza bekungadala ukuthi luphahlazeke noma lume. Leyo nkinga isixazululiwe.

Izilungiso zokuthembeka nokusebenziseka

Inqwaba yezilungiso ithuthukisa ukuthembeka kwansuku zonke kuzo zonke izingxenye zesistimu:

kyctl : Amaphutha okuxhumana nesendlalelo sokulawula manje aboniswa ngokucacile esikhundleni sokuthi kwehluleke buthule, okwenza ukuxazulula izinkinga kube lula kakhulu.

kycontroller : Kulungiswe iphutha lapho imbobo yomphakathi elungiselelwe yeseva yayigcinwa ngendlela engalungile kunqolobane, bese amaklayenti enikezwa amanani aphelelwe yisikhathi.

kycontroller : Kuxazululwe ukuvaleleka obekungenza isiphetho se-/login sivimbeke unomphela lapho imicu eminingi incintisana ngesikhiya esisodwa.

kycontroller : Iluphu yokwamukela ukuxhumana kwezokuthutha kwe-QUIC manje isiqine kakhulu lapho kuvela izimo ezingavamile ekuphatheni ukuxhumana okungenayo.

kynput/win32 : Izinguquko zezilungiselelo zekhibhodi manje ziqashwa ngesikhathi uhlelo lusebenza, ukuze okufakwayo kuqhubeke kusebenza kahle ngisho noma umsebenzisi eshintsha izilungiselelo zekhibhodi phakathi neseshini.

kyclient : Imikhawulo yesikhathi ye-HTTP isengeziwe kuzo zonke izicelo eziphumayo kumaklayenti edeskithophu nawewebhu, okuvimbela uhlelo ukuthi lume lapho inethiwekhi ingasebenzi kahle.

kyctl manje isikwazi ukukhiqiza okhiye be-JWT ngqo emgqeni womyalo, okwenza ukuphathwa kwezitifiketi namathokheni kube lula ngaphandle kokudinga amathuluzi angaphandle.

Buyekeza

I-Kyber 0.25 isiyatholakala manje.

Vakashela ikhasi lokulanda ukuze uthole inguqulo yakamuva, noma uthole amaphakheji abuyekeziwe ngendlela ojwayele ukuyisebenzisa.

Imibono nemibiko yamaphutha yamukelekile kakhulu.
